reply.text:
Mostly nay if you're lifting for size or strength. Research on cold water right after training suggests it can blunt some of the muscle-building signal, so if you're chasing growth, it works against the very thing you just trained for. It does feel great and can take the edge off soreness, which is a fine reason to use it on a day when you're not trying to maximize adaptation, like after a hard conditioning session or a competition. My call is to lift, then wait a few hours or save the plunge for a rest day. If your goal is just feeling fresh and enjoying it, nobody's going to stop you.

If you have a heart condition or any health concern, check with your doctor before you start plunging.
